text:
Kevin: FYI starting a tiny rollout of rwd-v2.1-quant4 on rerank/search. plan: 1% -> 5% over 10m. I want the A/B sanity rubric and exact auto-fallback thresholds before we open beyond 1%. :eyes:
Sophia: noted. internal eval showed longdoc MRR -0.7% vs baseline on q4 for the top-k rerank slice. short-answer slices looked fine.
AJ: can we target slice checks: longdoc, code-snippets, and short-answer? recommends running the smoke eval on live-ish traffic slices. link to the eval job: https://internal.redwood/evals/29821
Maria: propose an emergency-fallback rule: trigger when both: 1) delta_mrr <= -0.5% (rolling 15m) AND 2) hallucination_rate increase >= 0.3pp OR precision@10 drop >= 0.6pp. add latency guard: p99 increase > 120ms. pseudoconfig below:
```
auto_fallback:
  window: 15m
  rules:
    - name: quality_regression
      condition: delta_mrr <= -0.005 AND (hallucination_delta >= 0.003 OR precision10_delta <= -0.006)
    - name: latency_spike
      condition: latency_p99_delta >= 0.120
  required_signals: 1  # OR across rules triggers fallback
  min_samples: 1000
  pvalue_threshold: 0.05
```
Kevin: can we confirm sample math? for 1% traffic we expect ~1.5k sessions / 10m on rerank. AJ, you had a calc for min samples for 95% power?
AJ: quick calc: rough baseline conversion variability -> need ~9-12k users to detect 0.5% relative MRR drop at 95% power. so 1% for 10m is small. suggestion: keep 1% for 20m then jump to 5% for 30m, or keep 1% + shadowing to bulk up samples.
Sophia: agree on shadowing. also add a cohort-level scoreboard for the longdoc slice (MRR, recall@k, hallucination rate) pushed to #monitoring-alerts if any metric breaches deets.
Maria: add a sanity p-value gate: require p >= 0.05 (two-sided) to proceed, and fail-open on insufficient samples -> don't escalate traffic until min_samples reached. plus a soft-stop if oscillation observed (delta_mrr sign flips 3x in 30m).
rollout-bot: rollout created: rwd-v2.1-quant4 -> route rerank. initial_traffic=0.01 target_traffic=0.05 ramp=10m auto_fallback=enabled. rollout id 4f9c0b
Kevin: launching now with the above config. I will watch the longdoc scoreboard for first 40m. please react here if you see any spike or if we should abort. :thumbsup:
Sophia: :thumbsup:
AJ: will monitor samples + p-values, pinging once we hit min_samples.
Maria: I added the fallback config to the rollout and the monitor dashboards. If fallback fires, please include the dump id for triage: diag.dump=${ROLLBACK_DUMP_ID} in the incident ticket.
Kevin: thanks everyone. keeping this thread as the single source for escalation.
